lesson: Primary link coverage is separate from refinement confidence. Completeness means every eligible URL is attempted; refinement upgrades inconclusive results.
Model readiness is not model review completion. Scan guidanceSource stays deterministic until Ask Frank completes a model review.
A wrong Highlight is worse than no Highlight. Stale or mismatched targets must not claim success.
Absence of underline does not imply absence of a persistent non-color cue (e.g. border-bottom).
